newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 26.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mali's president, Alpha Oumar Konare, says after talks with Ivorian President Henri Konan Bedie that his country is prepared to send troops to help keep peace in Zaire and Central Africa's Great Lakes region

- Ivory Coast, its rain forest dwindling, targets 21 percent sustainable tree cover of its territory, junior agriculture and livestock minister Amadou Ouattara tells workshop on the sector; Government aims for self-financing timber industry yielding production of four million cubic metres of wood a year by 2015. - British trade mission arrives in Ivory Coast today

- African coffee producing countries to meet in Abidjan on March 6 and 7 to discuss export quotes to sustain prices - Head of Africa region organisation for satellite communications RASCOM, Gounde Adadja, says the group aims to invite tenders for an African satellite before the end of the year with 2001 as the target launch date; ministers from member countries will examine the project in May in South Africa - As much as 57 percent of Ivory Coast's population is unable to read or write, national statistics institute study shows
